title: TAT-3407 — Auto Close modal price context (entry / current / liquidation)
description: Proves the Extension Auto Close (TP/SL) modal opened from an active position shows Entry price, Current price, and Liquidation price rows above the Take profit section using the adaptive-precision perps formatter; that the order-entry Auto Close section does NOT show the block (no regression); and that the current price renders the live market value.

setup-open-eth.intent: Open an active ETH Perps position so the Auto Close modal has entry/current/liquidation data

ac1-assert-eth-open.intent: AC1/AC4: assert an open ETH position exists (source of entry/current/liquidation prices)

ac1-nav-market.intent: AC1: open the ETH Perps market detail page that hosts the Auto Close modal trigger

ac1-wait-auto-close-row.intent: AC1: wait until the Auto Close row (modal trigger) is visible for the open position

ac1-open-modal.intent: AC1: open the Auto Close (TP/SL) modal from the active position

ac1-wait-price-info.intent: AC1: wait until the price-context block is visible inside the Auto Close modal

ac1-wait-entry-row.intent: AC1: wait until the Entry price row is visible

ac1-wait-current-row.intent: AC1: wait until the Current price row is visible

ac1-wait-liq-row.intent: AC1: wait until the Liquidation price row is visible

ac4-wait-entry-value.intent: AC4: entry price renders a formatted ($) value via the adaptive perps formatter

ac2-wait-current-value.intent: AC2: current price renders the live ($) market value bound to the page's live currentPrice prop

ac4-wait-liq-value.intent: AC4: liquidation price renders a formatted ($) value via the adaptive perps formatter

ac1-screenshot-price-block.intent: AC1/AC4: capture the Auto Close modal showing the entry/current/liquidation block above the Take profit section
ac1-screenshot-price-block.note: AC1/AC4: Auto Close modal for an open ETH position shows Entry/Current/Liquidation price rows with adaptive-precision values, stacked above the Take profit section header.

ac3-nav-order-entry.intent: AC3: open the order-entry screen whose Auto Close section must NOT show the price block

ac3-wait-section.intent: AC3: confirm the order-entry Auto Close section renders (the surface that must NOT show the price block)

ac3-assert-no-block.intent: AC3: assert the entry/current/liquidation price block is ABSENT on the order-entry Auto Close surface (no regression). This wait fails if the block leaks onto order entry.

teardown-close-eth.intent: Restore Perps state by closing the ETH position opened for proof
